key_insight: Turbulent cross helicity can grow exponentially in sheared, inhomogeneous magnetohydrodynamic turbulence when shear-driven production exceeds effective losses.
engineering_relevance: This instability may inform modeling of energy transfer and magnetic-field generation in conducting-fluid systems with strong shear.
method: Analytically derive a cross-helical shear instability.
Identify production from a nonzero Reynolds–Maxwell stress gradient.
Test the predicted growth using three-dimensional numerical simulations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that three-dimensional simulations confirm the analytically predicted exponential growth.
watch_item: Growth requires a nonzero stress gradient and shear above a threshold set by the ratio of turbulent magnetic to momentum diffusivities.
paper_title: Exponential Growth of Turbulent Cross Helicity in Shear-Flow-Driven Turbulence
